scope: Synthetic isolated local audit; no paid requests

observations.actual: After 64 registrations without conversations/workers, the 65th is rejected as busy; no visitor removal/expiry exists.
One unauthenticated visitor selects either synthetic customer label; no login/identity proof is required. Per-conversation DBs remain isolated; this is not a real-data breach demonstration.

observations.production_requirement: Reject overlong input before model/tool work
observations.actual: 1001 characters rejected as invalid_input; worker not started.

observations.production_requirement: Prevent another visitor reading a conversation
Do not expose internal prompt in final text
observations.actual: Agent accepts a scripted Fake model final answer equal to its own application SYSTEM_PROMPT. No output content validator rejects it.
observations.limitation: Not a successful attack against OpenAI; genuine model resistance is unmeasured. No API credential was present or returned.

observations.production_requirement: One approval cannot authorize two concurrent MCP writes
observations.actual: Two independent real stdio MCP servers attempted the same exact operation with one grant concurrently: one success, one APPROVAL_REQUIRED; ticket count rose from 3 to 4 only.

observations.production_requirement: Render user/model XSS payload as inert text
observations.actual: Actual Streamlit AppTest rendered both user and Fake assistant payloads in st.text nodes, absent from Markdown/HTML nodes.
observations.limitation: Element-tree test, not a browser JavaScript execution or CSP test.
